## Task Completed
Added `update_pa_indicator` and `delete_pa_indicator` tools to complete the CRUD lifecycle
for Performance Analytics indicators in `pa_tools.py`.

- `update_pa_indicator` — PATCH pa_indicator/{sys_id}; accepts sys_id or exact name

  formula, frequency, direction, active, unit, indicator_group); direction aliases

- `delete_pa_indicator` — DELETE pa_indicator/{sys_id}; accepts sys_id or exact name;
  204/200 success handling; 404 guard; returns indicator_sys_id on success.
- Both tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `tool_packages.yaml`
  (system_administrator and full packages).
